team_formation_request_text_lengths.name: team_formation_request_text_lengths
team_formation_request_text_lengths.value: char_length("team_formation_request"."proposed_name") between 1 and 40 and ("team_formation_request"."note" is null or char_length("team_formation_request"."note") <= 500) and ("team_formation_request"."decline_reason" is null or char_length("team_formation_request"."decline_reason") <= 500)

game_final_has_score.name: game_final_has_score
game_final_has_score.value: "game"."status" <> 'final' or ("game"."score_a" is not null and "game"."score_b" is not null and "game"."finalized_at" is not null)

game_forfeit_by_a_team.name: game_forfeit_by_a_team
game_forfeit_by_a_team.value: ("game"."status" = 'forfeit') = ("game"."forfeit_by" is not null) and ("game"."forfeit_by" is null or "game"."forfeit_by" in ("game"."team_a_id", "game"."team_b_id"))

announcement_text_lengths.name: announcement_text_lengths
announcement_text_lengths.value: char_length("announcement"."subject") between 1 and 120 and char_length("announcement"."body") between 1 and 5000

team_constraint_has_date_or_time.name: team_constraint_has_date_or_time
team_constraint_has_date_or_time.value: "team_constraint"."on_date" is not null or "team_constraint"."time_index" is not null

season_fees_non_negative.name: season_fees_non_negative
season_fees_non_negative.value: coalesce("season"."team_fee_cents", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("season"."player_fee_cents", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("season"."free_agent_fee_cents", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("season"."early_bird_discount_cents", 0) >= 0

season_fee_matches_model.name: season_fee_matches_model
season_fee_matches_model.value: ("season"."fee_model" = 'per_team' and "season"."team_fee_cents" is not null) or ("season"."fee_model" = 'per_player' and "season"."player_fee_cents" is not null)

season_registration_window.name: season_registration_window
season_registration_window.value: "season"."registration_closes_at" is null or "season"."registration_opens_at" is null or "season"."registration_closes_at" > "season"."registration_opens_at"

roster_membership_dates_order.name: roster_membership_dates_order
roster_membership_dates_order.value: "roster_membership"."ended_at" is null or "roster_membership"."started_at" is null or "roster_membership"."ended_at" >= "roster_membership"."started_at"
